headline: Venstre's leader calls the party's executive to an extraordinary meeting
deck: The executive meets on 25 October, after the party's worst election result and its lowest poll in Voxmeter's history.
standard: Troels Lund Poulsen, leader of Venstre, a liberal party, has called its national executive to an extraordinary meeting in Nyborg, a town on Funen, on 25 October. The agenda has one item: the current political situation.
'After some hard weeks for Venstre it is natural to gather and discuss the way forward,' Stephanie Lose, the deputy leader, told Ritzau, a Danish news agency.
The party took 10.1 per cent at the election in March, its worst result. Voxmeter, a polling firm, put it at 5.8 per cent on 21 September and 7.4 on Monday.
Two commentators quoted by Berlingske call the meeting 'uncommonly unusual' and a sign of crisis.
short: Troels Lund Poulsen, leader of Venstre, a liberal party, has called its national executive to an extraordinary meeting on 25 October to discuss the current political situation. The party took 10.1 per cent at the election in March, its worst result.
